name: TrueWood Grey Oak Slats, Black Felt
summary: Solid rubberwood slats with real grey oak veneer on all visible sides, mounted on black acoustic felt.

texture.note: No manufacturer spec sheet was published: estimated 7 slats per recorded 11.8 in panel, with 1.18 in faces, 0.506 in black-felt gaps and 1.686 in pitch; total depth is the recorded 0.75 in (backing and chamfer profile estimated). The tile spans 7 pitches by 23.6 in, with procedural wrapping grain and grey-oak tones sampled only from the main listing photo.
